Running it
----------
simcity.d88 is a disk image for an NEC PC-6001mkII with its disk unit (the
PC-6031: a 5.25 inch disk, one side, 40 tracks).  Put it in the first drive
and reset the machine (or start the emulator with it in the first drive): it
boots straight into the game, with no BASIC or other disk needed, and shows
a line of dots, one for each track, as it loads.  The disk only boots on the
mkII: its boot sector checks the ROM and hands the machine back if it is
not a mkII's.

The game uses the 320 x 200 screen in four colours (green, yellow, blue and
red) as a grid of 40 by 25 cells, with the effects on the sound chip.  Parts
of the game (the budget, the evaluation, the file screens and the start)
are read from the disk when they are needed, so a slow drive pauses for a
moment as they open.  Cities are saved to and loaded from the same disk, in
one of six slots after the game itself (so the disk must not be write
protected, and the image file is changed when you save).  The map is 96 x 96
squares and there are no scenarios.

This has been run in Takeda's mkII emulation, and its disk driver, the
overlays and its timer and keyboard interrupts under a model of the machine;
a real mkII and its disk unit are untested.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square
  Q A O P         up, down, left, right (shifted: eight squares)
  Space           build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters
